THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned High Court Government Pleader accepts notice for respondent No.1.
2.

Smt. M. Radhika, learned counsel filed vakalath on behalf of respondent No.2.
3.

This petition is filed by the petitioners-accused Nos.1 and 2 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in C.C.No.8628/2020 arising out of Crime No.96/2020 registered by Rajagopalanagar Police Station, Bengaluru, for the offence punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending on the file of VII ACMM, Bengaluru.

4. During pendency of the petition, both petitioners and respondent No.2 appeared before the Court along with their counsels and filed joint compromise application along with affidavit on I.A.No.1/2023 under Section 320(2) and 320(8) of Cr.P.C. seeking permission of this Court to compound the offence and submits that they have settled their dispute between them amicably.

Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 have already obtained mutual consent divorce in M.C.No.7787/2022 before the III Additional Family Court, Bengaluru.
